response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_duration) AS avg_duration_overall, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio_overall FROM (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) AS avg_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) subquery;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff of 20.99 is interpreted as >= (greater than or equal to), so films with replacement_cost = 20.99 are included in 'pricier-to-replace'.

alternatives.interpretation: The cutoff of 20.99 could mean replacement_cost > 20.99, excluding films with exactly 20.99.
